decisions.reason: The certified HVAC plate exchanger line is close to the core offer, and with industry turnover growing there is no clear shortfall against aspiration, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 leaves its results uncertain.
The claimed major market share in water cooling systems suggests performance at or above aspiration, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The marine cooling unit complements the successful box cooler line, and the slack of a growing, hiring firm allows it to be carried while its results firm up.
The finned tube is a component that supports the core air cooler business at low marginal cost, and there is no evidence of underperformance against aspiration.
